additions.group: 極小・印刷数式画像からTypstへの構造認識
additions.reason_selected: Independent small image-to-Typst learned state from project-seeded random initialization, not a format conversion or generic OCR derivative. Direct editable scientific formula output and small FP32 checkpoint complement selected LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, DeepSeek-OCR-2 and conditional TATR; keep full document OCR, no replacement evidence. Preserve optimizer-free original FP32 state once, not separate INT8 export assets.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher document-disjoint FP32 validation: exact match 92.6268% over 16899 crops; <=32 tokens 97.8519%; independently initialized 14,157,152 parameter CNN/axial 2D context/three-layer Transformer decoder. 129303 training crops from 480 documents; validation 60 other documents. Direct package-free Typst output, no pretrained external learned dependency.
additions.quality_negative: Publisher validation-selected checkpoint, held-out test unopened; 33–64 tokens 88.4282% below own 90% gate, display formulas 70.1197%, matrices and accents errors. Printed tight single crop only, not handwriting or page OCR. No matched incumbent test, hardware/clock/batch/latency/peak memory or independent replay. INT8 built-in probe parity only; full-domain INT8 evaluation not completed.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Benign document/education/scientific transcription; potential wrong mathematical symbols require validation. No current observed access restriction change or deletion forecast. Rights, owner access, code trust and acquisition independent; KEEP incumbent document OCR.
additions.observed_access: Public model card, fixed tree and Xet pointer visible; API gate state and owner entitlement not verified
